problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must load packages onto identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 66 units
* Package 2: size 50 units
* Package 3: size 42 units
* Package 4: size 56 units
* Package 5: size 62 units
* Package 6: size 62 units
* Package 7: size 37 units
* Package 8: size 65 units
* Package 9: size 36 units
* Package 10: size 60 units
* Package 11: size 37 units
* Package 12: size 62 units
* Package 13: size 58 units
* Package 14: size 60 units
* Package 15: size 41 units
* Package 16: size 59 units
* Package 17: size 65 units
* Package 18: size 51 units
* Package 19: size 38 units
* Package 20: size 56 units
* Package 21: size 46 units
* Package 22: size 54 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total size of packages on any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
